body: A $6.3 billion heist at Binance shows how AI tools can be a double-edged sword. Hackers reportedly used fake job interviews along with an internal AI tool to pull off this massive theft. This incident highlights a troubling trend: AI isn't just advancing security, it's also evolving the threat landscape. AI's role here wasn't just about brute force or speed. It was about deception. The use of AI in creating convincing fake interviews indicates a level of sophistication that traditional security measures might not catch. This isn't just a wake-up call for Binance, but for any company using AI in sensitive environments. The takeaway? As AI becomes more integrated into our systems, our approach to security and governance needs to evolve. Companies, especially in APAC, must reassess how they manage AI tools. It's not just about having the latest technology, but ensuring robust governance to mitigate these advanced threats.
